correctness.rationale: Idempotence gives a disjoint union of coloured rooted-star fibres. Every automorphism preserves fibre types; factorial and wreath-product factors give an exact integer group order. Exactly two arises from one internal doubled leaf-colour or one duplicated rigid component, disjointly. Their size enumerators give F_q. Rigidity weights have gap-free subset sums, yielding full support and sharp cutoff N_q+q+2, with q^2 maximal choices. Independent finite permutation enumeration checked all admissible labelled models in the declared ranges. Exact general proof does not rely on a finite test.
